Collect the isolated fractions for protein concentration determination.
Centrifuge the isolated fractions at 13,000 rpm at 4°C for 10 minutes to pellet any insoluble material.
Perform the BCA protein assay on the supernatant following the kit's protocol.
Read the absorbance of the samples using a spectrophotometer.
Calculate the protein concentration of the samples using the standard curve provided with the BCA protein assay kit.
